articles.title: How to make a fee receipt
articles.summary: Make fee receipts in Nivesh Sahayak: student, months, fee heads, concession, previous dues and part payments; next month's receipt in one press.

articles.title: All fee receipts from an Excel sheet
articles.card: All fee receipts from an Excel sheet
articles.summary: Drop your fee sheet (a row per student, a column per fee head): every fee receipt numbered in series as one PDF or zip, a fee register and messages to parents.
